channel.title: CashDublo — App Updates
channel.description: App releases, features and product notices from CashDublo.

item.title: Indy Travel adds hotel-price watching
item.description: A planned hotel-price monitoring feature lets users track a chosen property and receive an alert when its price changes.
item.author: Greg Odom

item.title: Contracts adds a paper-vault workflow
item.description: Contracts is expanding beyond signing to help users keep important documents organized and easy to retrieve.
item.author: Greg Odom

item.title: Every app is getting a plain-words manual
item.description: Contracts and Wi-Fi Tether have customer-facing manuals. The same clear, self-service help standard is being extended across the app collection.
item.author: Greg Odom

item.title: The CashDublo App Store gets its download engine
item.description: The store's download engine is designed to resume interrupted downloads instead of starting over.
item.author: Greg Odom
